title: ci: Workflow tweaks
body:
Tweaks to the workflows, trying to make everything a bit more efficient/faster. Some are discussable, do not hesitate to shoot at them:

- Drop `key: ${{ github.ref_name }}` from all 12 rust-cache blocks (never matching any existing cache since using the branch name as the cache key)
- Drop `workspaces: py-polars` (does not exist)
- Remove sccache (~30% of the 10GiB quota)
- Clearing caches becomes a daily prune (keeping only the latest version of dependencies for each job) instead of a weekly `delete --all` (costing a cold build once a week); this yields to a funky script...
- Coverage on push to `main` only (removes also the issue with documentation-related jobs running it)
- Test (again) to run the coverage jobs on `ubuntu-latest` to avoid queueing for macOS machines; if it does not work, we can try something like `-C link-arg=-Wl,--build-id=sha1` but let's see if it makes it first
- Delete `test-pyodide.yml` (triggers on a branch that does not exist?) and never ran

As usual, CI can only be tested properly when it runs. The main issue with the current workflows is caching, which was never applied correctly; we should [hopefully] see an improvement, but only after a bit of time.

**EDIT:** once/if we merge this we need to nuke the whole cache (dispatching the `clear-cache.yml` workflow below, checking the `all` box) or we will have stale caches idling for 7 days.
